name: Dragon Gauntlets
shortDescription: A mismatched pair of metal dragon gauntlets combining different pattern sources, modified with claw-like fingers and thick leather wrists.
description: The Dragon Gauntlets use patterns that I do not own. The left gauntlet follows the original pattern, while the right combines a Prince Armory bracer pattern with the glove pattern.
I modified the finger pattern so the fingers resemble claws. Most of the gauntlets are metal, with thick leather used around the wrists.

details.Right Gauntlet: Prince Armory bracer pattern combined with glove pattern
